methodology.batch: one batch of 150 (SQ001-SQ100 + EQ01-EQ50), sliced; no cross-batch splicing
methodology.config: frozen v7 — nothing retuned for this measurement
methodology.tier_tables: heldout50 only (extra100 has no tier field)
methodology.gold_route_tables: extra100 only (heldout50 has no gold route label)
methodology.common_axis: P3 predicted route — defined for every question in both sets
methodology.answer_from_caveat: 70/100 extra100 questions have gold answers identical to this project's own KG edges (verified on audited_by: EY 32/32, PwC 31/31, Deloitte 24/24, KPMG 12/12). Every extra100 table is therefore also split by answer_from; the 30 '10-K text, LLM-verified' rows are the headline, the 70 'graph edges' rows a graph-recall diagnostic.
